links.outcome: Parental HPV vaccination intent, chatbot versus government public health materials, over 45 days
links.effect: Immediate intent: materials d=0.53, default chatbot d=0.48, conversational chatbot d=0.33 vs no intervention. At 45 days neither chatbot increased intent; materials kept modest effects.
links.quote: At 45 days, neither chatbot increased intent relative to controls, whereas public health materials maintained modest effects.

links.outcome: Self-reported HPV vaccination uptake at 15 and 45 days after chatbot exposure
links.effect: No intervention, including the chatbots, increased self-reported vaccination uptake; chatbot intent effects did not persist at 45 days.
links.quote: No intervention increased self-reported vaccination uptake.

screen.reason: Randomized controlled trial evaluating the efficacy of an LLM chatbot (GPT-4o) versus standard public health materials on parental HPV vaccination intention and behavior.
